$comment: VAPP-241 (eApps P1, docs/spec/apps.md §9.4, §18 item 5) PUBLIC LINKS ×4. A package declares `share: [{name, mode, kind, fields?, query?, expires?}]` (validated by eUI: packages/exponential-ui/docs/package-format.md "Public links"). An owner turns one on in the app's Settings tab: a row of `app_share_links` with a random token (`tokenBytes` bytes, unpadded base64url), the URL `urlPrefix`<token> on the server's base url. STATES (`linkState`, `stateCases`): no row or a revoked one = `off`; expired (`expires_at` <= now) = `expired`; the package no longer declares the share = `orphaned` (a guest gets `copy.gone`, the Settings row stays until revoked); else `on`. A guest of any state but `on` gets the one page `copy.gone`, the same answer as an unknown token, so a token's history never leaks. ENABLE = a new row (`enabled_by` = the owner, `expires_at` = now + the share's `expires` days, none = never). ROTATE = a new token on the same row (`rotated_at`): the old URL stops at once, `expires_at` and the sponsor stay. REVOKE = `revoked_at`; enabling again mints a NEW token. Owners only (`apps.shareLinks.{list, enable, rotate, revoke}`); `list` returns the rows of the PUBLISHED package's shares, no new synced shape. SUBMIT: a guest fills one RecordForm of the kind and creates exactly one record: `submitFields` (`fieldCases`): `fields` when declared (order kept), else the Data tab's order; files, computed and undeclared names dropped; a required field left out of `fields` is an install issue (the guest could never submit). The record = the share's sponsor: `author_id` = `created_by` = `enabled_by`, `share_name` = the share's name, R4 history `via` = `share:<name>`. A sponsor who is no longer a member or an owner closes the link (`copy.gone`). Honeypot: the form carries the invisible field `honeypot`; filled = answered like a success, nothing stored, audited `honeypot`. CAPS: `caps.perIpPerHour` submissions per hashed IP per link and `caps.perLinkPerHour` per link (`capCases`; over = HTTP 429 `copy.tooMany`), the plan's record quota and the schema validate as any write (an invalid body = 400 with the field issues, shown inline; the quota = `copy.closed`). Bodies ≤ `caps.maxBodyBytes`. AUDIT: every submission = one `app_share_submissions` row {link, record?, ip_hash (HMAC of the IP, never the IP), outcome (`outcomes`), created_at}, kept `caps.auditDays` days. VIEW: a frozen query, computed by the server per request, no shape and no live sync: the share's `query` narrowed to `viewFields` (`fieldCases`: `fields`, else every schema field; reserved keys other than `id` and `updatedAt`, authors and computed names outside `fields` dropped), at most `caps.viewRows` rows, rendered as a read-only RecordTable (`editable: false`, no Add); never another kind, no member data, no `exp:` source. DISPLAY (`bylineCases`, replayed ×4 wherever the By/author label shows): a record with `shareName` reads `copy.guest` instead of its author, on web, desktop and in R4's history subtitle. SETTINGS (testId `shareLinks`, shown when the published package declares shares; everyone reads it, owners act): the existing group heading `copy.title`, one ListRow per share (testId `shareRow`): title = the share's name, subtitle = `rowSubtitle` (`rowCases`): `{mode label} · {state label}`, with the expiry date when on; trailing a Switch (owner; on = enable, off = revoke) and, while on, the `…` menu `copy.copyLink` / `copy.newLink`. A failed action = the failed-action toast.

copy.title: Public links
copy.tooMany: Too many submissions, try again later

stateCases.name: the expiry instant counts as expired

fieldCases.name: declared fields keep their order, unknown names drop
no fields = the Data tab's order, files only in neither

bylineCases.name: a shared record reads Guest, not its sponsor
any other record keeps its byline
